title: Research Grants in Germany
summary: Funding for international doctoral students and postdocs to conduct a research project at a state or state-recognised university or non-university research institute in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Supports research stays during a doctorate or in the early postdoc phase.

subject_areas.notes: No discipline restrictions mentioned on page; human medicine, veterinary medicine and dentistry have further regulations.

institutions.notes: State or state-recognised universities or non-university research institutes in Germany.

nationality.notes: Origin-unspecified DAAD programme page listing specific countries in selection dropdown, but no explicit eligibility country restrictions listed in the text.

residence.notes: You cannot apply if you are doing your entire doctorate at a German university, or have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

mandatory.text: Doctoral students: Start of doctorate should not be more than 3 years ago at application deadline.
Postdocs: Should not have completed doctorate more than 4 years before application deadline.
Must not have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.
Research project must be carried out in agreement with a scientific supervisor in Germany.

funding.description: Monthly scholarship payments of 1,400 euros for doctoral students (implied by standard or general rate, though exact rate specified as 1.400 euros), health, accident and personal liability insurance cover, travel allowance (if funding period exceeds 6 months), research allowance of 460 euros for funding periods over six months.
funding.duration: doctoral students: 2 to 12 months; postdocs: 2 to 6 months

application_rounds.notes: Application deadlines are updated annually in the second quarter. Currently you cannot apply for this programme.

recurring_deadline_notes: Application deadlines are updated annually in the second quarter. In most cases, they are in the same period as the previous year.

required_documents.text: full curriculum vitae in tabular form (max. 3 pages)
list of your published publications (max. 10 pages; mandatory for postdocs)
time schedule of planned research work
proof of admission to doctoral studies/enrolment for doctoral studies (for doctoral students)
confirmation from the academic host in Germany
Declaration from the scientific supervisor in Germany on safety-relevant and ethical aspects
all university degree certificates you have already obtained
One recent supporting letter of recommendation (on a DAAD-form)

steps.text: Prepare application documents and translations if necessary
Fill out application form and upload documents in PDF format

sources.title: Research Grants in Germany - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme supports doctoral students and postdocs physically carrying out a research project in Germany.
